title: To the students who found the Tortoise and the Hare and the Town Mouse and the Country Mouse in the "fables" section of our diverse book list....touch
summary: To the students who found the Tortoise and the Hare and the Town Mouse and the Country Mouse in the "fables" section of our diverse book list....touche...you completed the assignment...but missed the point. That is on me not you.
author: Greg McVerry
